title: Preservation of runs under step correspondence
statement: Let $M$ and $M'$ be oracle Turing machines, with oracle languages $O$ and $O'$, respectively. Suppose a map $f$ from configurations of $M$ to configurations of $M'$ satisfies $M'$'s one-step update with oracle $O'$ at $f(c)$ equals $f$ of $M$'s one-step update with oracle $O$, for every configuration $c$. Then, for every configuration $c$ and every nonnegative integer $n$, running $M'$ from $f(c)$ for $n$ steps yields $f$ of the configuration obtained by running $M$ from $c$ for $n$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Machines M and M' and oracle languages O and O'
A map f from configurations of M to configurations of M'
The one-step correspondence holds for every configuration
